website_summary.name: Detective Case Tracker
website_summary.description: The website has a sleek beige background and a structured layout with modular cards, rendering a professional detective agency interface for case management and tracking.
website_summary.appearance: The website features a beige background with components styled in saddle brown, ensuring a cohesive and professional appearance. It includes a left-hand side navigation menu with options like 'Cases', 'Reports', 'Work Hours', 'Expenses', and 'Assignments'. To the right, the main panel displays case cards arranged in a grid. Each card lists case details such as the case title, description, status (e.g., 'In Progress', 'Open', 'Closed'), and metadata like date, hours logged, and expenses. A 'New Case' button is visible at the top right within the main content area, facilitating user-initiated case creation.
website_summary.functionality: The website offers functionality for managing detective cases. Functions include browsing existing cases displayed on case cards, creating new cases via a dedicated 'New Case' button, viewing case details, logging work hours and expenses, and seeing service assignment sheets. Users can click on any case card to get in-depth information about the case. The 'New Case' button opens a modal dialog where users can enter information like case title and details.
